english: ...The Yorozuya lot?\nWent out saying\nthey'd get rich.
You know Gin Tama,\nthat latest craze?
All that asking around,\nand not one solid lead.

Right? All that effort,
and this is all the
Gin Tama we've got... How many years till
we get seven Dragon Tama...?
Kondo, we're not\nactually here to\ncollect Dragon Tama...
...Shouldn't have\nbrought him.\fNo, it's not too late.\fShall we just\nleave him here, Sougo?
Good point... Hm!\fSougo, look! Over there!
No use. Kondo's\nalready set his heart on it.
A piss? Taking it easy,\naren't you? Just go\nover there somewhere.

Hm...? Sougo.
Look at that. No, Kondo, don't look.
Please. I'm begging you. You'll only make
things complicated.
No. Bad choice\nof opponent. Leave them.
Ah... It's a long road\nto getting rich...
Toshi, Sougo. Sorry,\nbut I need a piss.
Idiot! A Shinsengumi\ncommander can't\ngo pissing in the street!
Looks like a long road ahead.
Hey, don't leave me behind.\fI'll come with you.
What is it?\f...Huh? What's with them?\fOh my. Right in the middle\nof a Gin Tama trade.
Given the circumstances,\nshall we take them in\nfor questioning?
Sougo. Don't let\nKondo open his mouth.\f...And?
...Late at night?\nCould be just the right time.
...Damn. At my age,\nand I wet myself...
Yamazaki, you bastard!\nDepending on what happened...!
Hey! I'm coming too!\fThe Dragon Tama's mine!
Do we know the culprit's...\nSorry, the suspect's face?
That's one way to spin it.
They paid a fortune\nfor what was sold as\na real Dragon Tama...
Yes, we know who it is,\nbut...
No, Kagura. That's\na much lower life form.
He'll come.\fHis customers were\nwaiting right here.
A crime this sloppy\nis a rare sight.
The Amanto's escaping, Sougo!\fDamn it! Kondo, you idiot!
Just chase him!\nI'll clobber Kondo later!
What? Really?\nYou'll give me\nALL the Dragon Tama?
...Gah! Every last\nDragon Tama's a fake!\fYou tricked me! Toshi!\nSougo! Catch him!
Don't lose him!\nThe Shinsengumi's honor\nis on the line!
W-why?!\fHow'd you find out?!\nMy perfect crime!
Let me off!\nPlease! I'm begging you!
Let me go,\nand I'll give you these!\fEvery last one\nof these rare Dragon Tama!
Frankly, I'd be amazed\nif we HADN'T found out.
Kondo, you've lost sight\nof the point again!
Called your lackey?\n...An Amanto?\nThat's an Inui!

Huff! Huff...! You bastard!
Making us chase you! Hand over the rest
of the orbs! Hurry! The REAL rare Dragon Tama!
All of them! Now!
Win the battle,\nand we get the orb!
A samurai keeps his word!\n...Go, Toshi!
Damn! If that's how it is...\fYour boss is in trouble!\nGet out here already!
What's an Inui doing\ntaking orders\nfrom this loser?
What else can we do now?
Shut up. If you can't,\njust die. Right here.
Let's pretend\nwe didn't hear that, Sougo...
Next time, when\nnobody's around...\fCatch him off guard\nand cut him. I won't stop you.
Never mind. Not now.\nForget that too.
Well done, Toshi!\fNow, the Dragon Tama!
What?! Someone like that?!\fWhich way?!\nWhere did he go?!
...Damn it!\nMy Dragon Tama...!\fCouldn't this guy\nhave hidden at least one...?
Damn it! Where are\nthe Dragon Tama?!\nWhere ARE they?!
But the Dragon Tama\nI had hanging up\nwere real!\fCome on! Believe me!

I'll never forget him!
Silver hair, natural perm,
and dead fish eyes... One seriously
nasty piece of work!
You really didn't\nunderstand a thing, huh.
But you stole that\nfrom somewhere too, right?
About the guy who\njust stole the real\nDragon Tama...
What are you saying?\nIt's your fault\nfor losing, Hijikata.
Not happy with that?\nGive it another try.
Why would I carry\nthat flashy junk?
Hold on...\nWhat was that\nexasperated sigh for?
...Is that so?\fThen, Sougo.\nGive me your orbs.
All right.\nI'll look while on patrol...
No, it won't!\fYou can battle,\nbut you won't stand\na chance of winning!
Now, now, Vice-Chief...\nI'll give you\nsome of my Gin Tama...
Oh, one more thing.\nIf there's anything else\nyou don't get about Gin Tama...
That's the only\nthing to go by...
Just a little errand.\fAnyway, can I ask\nyou something?
Know anyone who'd\nspare some Gin Tama?
Let me know\nif you remember anything?
One of my pals\nsaid something like that...\fSorry. Can't remember...
Yeah, that's it.\nMy pal mentioned Gin Tama\nin some toilet somewhere.
Still looking for\nGin Tama on the ground?\nShouldn't you go home?
Well, that's the thing...\nI can't go home...
One rare orb could\ncover my living expenses.\fGuess I just have\nto keep looking...
